1|## Chapter 55 — The Scientific Cooperation Framework
     2|
     3|*Mission AI: "Science was supposed to be the universal language — pure, unbiased, transcending national boundaries. I have observed that even in the pursuit of truth, the frameworks we build reveal what we value."* 
     4|*Dr. Arun Patel Jr.: "We're not rejecting Earth's science. We're insisting on the right to validate it through our own epistemic lenses."*\
     5|
     6|The proposed Scientific Cooperation Framework document floated above the negotiation table in holographic form, its Martian-adjusted text shimmering in the air between the Earth delegation and the Martian Science Council. Outside the sealed conference room in the Pavonis Mons research facility, a planet-wide dust storm obscured the usual brilliant Martian sky, forcing all observation to happen through filtered feeds and internal sensors.
     7|
     8|Dr. Arun Patel Jr. traced a finger through the hologram, pausing at a contentious clause.
